'''Fumiko Orikasa''' (Japanese: '''折笠富美子''' ''Orikasa Fumiko'') is a Japanese voice actress for {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Orikasa was born on December 27, 1974, in {{wp|Tokyo}}, {{wp|Japan}}, and became a voice actress and singer as an adult. She became well-known for her roles in various anime series. Orikasa started her work on {{aniseries|PTS}} during the {{aniseries|GS|''Gold and Silver'' series}} by voicing various [[Character of the day|characters of the day]]. In the [[M05|fifth movie]], she played the role of {{OBP|Bianca|M05}}. However, her most prominent role was the [[Kalos League]] Champion [[Diantha]]. As a voice actress, Orikasa is currently affiliated with Atomic Monkey, while she is affiliated with Geneon Entertainment as a singer.
